description.short_caption: Erythematous and swollen foot with signs of inflammation.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a dorsal view of a foot with marked erythema, swelling, and a shiny appearance of the skin. The redness extends across the dorsal aspect and appears to involve the surrounding soft tissues. There are no visible open wounds or ulcerations, but the findings suggest significant inflammation, possibly cellulitis or another infectious process.

description.short_caption: Skin lesion with discoloration and necrosis on the forearm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a forearm with a prominent area of skin discoloration and necrosis. The lesion appears violaceous with central darkening, suggesting necrosis, and is surrounded by erythematous changes. The surrounding skin shows no overt swelling or additional lesions. The image suggests a localized infectious or vascular process.
